title: Leo's Order Came Out Wrong. Twice.

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.say: This isn't what I ordered. Again.
No pickles, it said. But the note was written so small, nobody on the line saw it. Twice.
Roma Tom brought the third one himself. You're right. That's on us. And dessert's on us too.

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.say: He fixed it in person. So I came back. No pickles, every time.

props.name: Leo
props.quote: He fixed it himself. So I *came back*.

scenes.say: So: put allergy and no-this notes in big letters on the ticket. Read them out at the pass. And when it's wrong twice, the owner takes the third plate.

props.title: Get it right
steps: Read changes out at the pass
Wrong twice? You take plate three
